description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding one mana of any color.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.
